title: SKE Crystal Watermelon Strawberry Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Watermelon Strawberry flavour SKE Crystal Nic Salts e-liquid blends the sweet taste of ripe watermelon with the fresh, tangy notes of strawberries, creating an irresistibly refreshing and fruity vape experience. This e-liquid is designed for those who love their vape to be bursting with vibrant and sunny fruit flavours. This e-liquid is a part of the larger SKE Crystal Nic Salts collection, renowned for its exceptional quality and flavour profiles. The nicotine salt formulation allows for a smoother inhalation, regardless of nicotine strength, making it a smart choice for those who prefer a gentle yet effective nicotine delivery. The 50VG/50PG ratio ensures a balanced vape, perfect for MTL devices. SKE are the creators of the hugely popular SKE Crystal Bar 600 disposable vape, a super-convenient single-use vape bar encased in a dazzling crystal chassis. SKE have since expanded their range with the SKE Crystal Plus pre-filled pod kit as well as this ever-evolving collection of Nicotine Salt 10ml e-liquids for use with many kinds of vape kit.
